texts.zh:
我们收我们接收到了来自[Root.GetName]的在进行紧急跃迁之前发出的最后的信号。其中指出他们所遇到的巨大的生物能跟踪舰队的超光速踪迹……

如果让那东西记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
texts.en:
We received one last transmission from the [Root.GetName] before the fleet engaged emergency FTL protocols and went dark. It includes mention of the gargantuan creature they had been fighting seemingly homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the beast has our scent, we should be prepared for savage retaliation.

texts.zh:
当以太巨龙攻击我们舰船的时候，它似乎可以追踪到我们飞船的超光速特征信号……

如果该生物记住了我们的气味，我们最好为之后的疯狂报复做好准备。
texts.en:
As the Ether Drake was attacking our vessels, it seemed to be homing in on the fleet's FTL signature...

If the creature has our scent, we should prepare for savage retaliation.

label.zh: 全体部队进入警戒状态。
